booleans-on-swept-carriers.label: Boolean algebra over lofted/swept/revolved (non-canonical-carrier) geometry
booleans-on-swept-carriers.note: Canonical-by-canonical booleans are landed. PB-011 routes the funnel-supported swept-carrier pairs (spline/swept/revolved carrier classes, the CFP-004 stage contract) through the facade's certified-entry dispatch at the bridge, so a row that boolean-composes only those routed forms is a lift candidate once its door run is green; a pair coupling a swept carrier with a funnel-refused class (torus) stays a typed refusal. This reason row remains the machine-checked evidence for the rows still staged, resolving to the BIE program's sweep-pair certification (BIE-006).

step-out.label: STEP export out of constructive/swept geometry
step-out.note: STEP out of constructive/swept surfaces is a typed kernel refusal; STL covers render and print. A row whose export target is STEP-only behind this boundary carries this typed reason.

rows.note: falcon_heavy_cutaway calls build_vehicle(cutaway=True): the 270-deg section opening is built from partial-arc revolves of the center-core tank barrel and interstage shells (CUT_START=135/CUT_ARC=270 in lib/falcon_common.py drive arc/start on eng.revolved_solid/eng.revolved_shell), so the prior 'boolean sectioning' label mis-describes the vendored code path. PB-011 LIFT EVIDENCE: the door run is green on the partial-arc revolve capability (PB-014) - build_vehicle(true) runs end to end (door_version 1, type Compound, solid_count 2164, bbox [[-5921.0,-2761.8,-1e-7],[5921.0,2650.0,70000.0]], STL 409322 triangles, ~11 s), and the row's manifest move to the runnable canonical set with its recorded reference fact is the orchestrator corpus-output step.

lib/aero.py build() intersects/subtracts the lofted master body (S.body_master, 26 spline-section loft, lib/surfaces.py:415-416) and lofted devices: _nose_body/_tail_body aero.py:57/:66, splitter/turning-vane/dive-plane blades aero.py:235/:258/:286, diffuser env/cavity/fin chain aero.py:374-396, rear tray aero.py:422, endplate - wing aero.py:521, pylon (lofted strut - tail body - wing) aero.py:578 - loft-carrier x canonical and loft x loft booleans.

lib/body.py build(): every panel is the lofted master shell booleaned: panel = body_skin() & region (body.py:161), skin - side-intake/aperture cutters (body.py:139-149), panels - underfloor prism - lamp lenses (body.py:163-166), pillar structure = canopy_glass_shell() - DLO openings (body.py:177); body_skin/canopy_glass_shell are loft-difference shells (lib/surfaces.py:526-550) - loft-carrier booleans throughout.

lib/brakes.py caliper is a revolved carrier edited by booleans: body + bosses/ears - bridge-window arc solids - half-space boxes (brakes.py:519-548, revolve at :501), hat = revolve - 15 canonical cylinders (brakes.py:391-404), disc band - revolved chamfer ring (brakes.py:328-335) - revolved-carrier x canonical/revolved booleans.

lib/chassis.py monocoque: tub is a 24-station spline loft unioned with lofted end plugs/walls/tunnel and cut by cylinders (chassis.py:389-424), then _tub_solids 'fused + extra' union (chassis.py:876-888) - loft-carrier booleans (chassis.py comments document OCCT failures on these).

lib/details.py _mirror: housing = (lofted pod - facet box) - pocket extrude (details.py:269-280, pod loft at :252-266); gill frame = lofted outer - lofted inner slab (details.py:418-426) - loft-carrier booleans.

lib/glazing.py build(): glass panes = canopy_glass_shell() & DLO region prisms, lamp lenses = body_skin() & lens region prisms (glazing.py:30-46; the shells are loft-difference solids at lib/surfaces.py:526-550) - loft-carrier intersects.

lib/hinge.py mechanism parts cut lofted/revolved carriers and every leaf is clipped to the door envelope: rail = rail-loft - rail-loft (hinge.py:338-356), mount-arm loft - bore (hinge.py:435-441), carrier collar revolve - bore (hinge.py:497-512), swing-arm loft - cutters (hinge.py:539-552), _clip_inboard shape & Box over every leaf incl. the helix-sweep screw thread (hinge.py:669-671) - loft/revolve/sweep-carrier booleans.

lib/interior.py seat shell is a 33-section spline loft (interior.py:196-236) slot-cut by a RectangleRounded prism per seat (interior.py:244); the remaining interior booleans (binnacle/pedal/buckle) are canonical-carrier - the reachable loft-carrier cut drives the skip.
lib/lighting.py front lamp bezel = lofted flank panel outer - lofted flank panel inner (lighting.py:660-668, _flank_panel bd.loft at :349-366) - loft x loft boolean.

lib/powertrain.py engine block fuses xz lofts with bank lofts (powertrain.py:243-249, lofts at :235-242 and :99-108); exhaust megaphone tip = lofted outer - lofted bore (powertrain.py:507-518) - loft-carrier booleans.

lib/suspension_front.py _upright fuses a 3-section rounded-rect loft steering arm into the machined billet (suspension_front.py:374-379); all other suspension-front booleans are canonical-carrier (pockets/bosses/bores over extrudes and cylinders) - the reachable loft-carrier fusion drives the skip.

lib/suspension_rear.py structural members fuse/cut 5-station periodic-spline lofts (_strut :258, _hull_plate :336, _upright_shell :523): wishbones body = body + strut(s) +/- rod-end housings/bores (:366-384, :421-432), upright shell pockets/bosses/bores (:537-559), rocker plate cut + bosses (:604-621), pushrod/toe-link/drop-link rod ends (:585/:730/:753) - loft x loft and loft x canonical booleans.
